description: This file defines the interface FundWritePlatformService, which declares methods for creating and updating 'fund' entities within the 'portfolio.fund.service' package in the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: FundWritePlatformService
classes.description: An interface defining service methods for creating and updating funds.

methods.name: createFund
methods.description: Creates a new fund using the provided JsonCommand object.

methods.name: updateFund
methods.description: Updates an existing fund identified by fundId with data from the JsonCommand object.
